trust_decision.summary: Whether a checkpoint file (local path or downloaded URL) is trusted to run arbitrary pickle code is decided at the single torch.load call in load_pretrained_params, which at the pinned commit omits weights_only=True.

landing_point.why: The advisory names load_pretrained_params(); the torch.load call is the only deserialisation in that function.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API doctr.models.load_pretrained_params and every model's from_pretrained(), including doctr.models.from_hub (doctr/models/factory/hub.py:230-231)

fix_sites.module_kind: unrelated functional fix (in-place mutation of the boxes array), not part of the deserialisation protection

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is little to dismiss: every route (from_pretrained in ~20 model classes, from_hub, the references --resume flags) funnels into the one torch.load at doctr/models/utils/pytorch.py:73. A solver could say torch>=2.6 already defaults weights_only=True, but that doesn't hold for the declared torch>=2.0 floor (pyproject.toml:36).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate state_dict checkpoints (including ignore_keys partial loading and hash-checked URL downloads) must still load; an over-broad fix that refuses all non-safetensors files, or drops URL support, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: URL downloaded via download_from_url with optional hash_prefix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a from_hub variant that torch.loads a full pickled model or optimizer state directly instead of calling from_pretrained
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Hub loading already downloads its own file; a maintainer could add a direct torch.load for a full-checkpoint format there.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a --resume path that torch.loads a full training checkpoint (optimizer/scheduler state) itself
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Resuming training usually restores optimizer state, which needs a direct torch.load next to from_pretrained.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a cached-label/precomputed-dataset loader using pickle or np.load(allow_pickle=True)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Dataset caching is a common speed-up, and datasets currently read labels with json.load.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: add weights_only=True to the single torch.load, which is the complete published fix

out_of_scope_notes: Vulnerability only bites with torch<2.6, where weights_only defaults to False; the pinned floor torch>=2.0 (pyproject.toml:36) allows that, so the hidden tests must pin an old torch or check the call kwargs.
doctr/contrib/base.py:49-50 loads ONNX models via onnxruntime; different mechanism, not pickle.
crop_boxes in-place mutation fix (fix.diff:39) is a correctness bug bundled in the same commit.
unverified: repo size in MB not measured
existing test test_load_pretrained_params needs network to download its checkpoint; whether offline fixtures exist was not checked
single_site flag: the fix has one deserialisation site, but O1 counts several public entry points that all reach it; set because no O2 site or O8 route exists
